answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 4799 Country: India Title: Kya admission ke liye commission dene jaiyz hai? Question: Kya admission ke liye commission dene jaiyz hai? Answer ID: 4799 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 901/834=D/1429) What do you mean by commission? If you mean bribe, then if you deserve the admission but it is difficult to get it without bribe, so it will be allowable to give bribe, though it will be haram for one to take it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
